# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Before proposing or editing code in this repository, read:
1. `/AI_CONTEXT.md`
2. `/AGENTS.md`
3. `/docs/13-PROJECT-STATUS.md`
4. the relevant file(s) in `/docs`
5. for any UI/UX/component work: `/docs/18-UI-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md`
6. for visual/responsive work: `/docs/19-UI-VISUAL-REFERENCE-MANIFEST.md`

The project is a single-author professional medical-writing portfolio and educational blog. The frozen stack is Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind + customized shadcn/ui + Supabase + Tiptap + Vercel.

The owner-accepted V1 visual system is **Warm Medical Editorial with Scientific Restraint — The Evidence Folio**. Do not replace it with default shadcn styling, a generic template, or a new design system.

Do not introduce out-of-scope systems, new frameworks, reader accounts, multi-author workflows, payments, subscriptions, ecommerce, telemedicine, AI medical advice, or page-builder functionality unless explicitly authorized.

Do not infer product behavior or factual client content from generated visual mockups. Mockup text/data are synthetic unless separately approved.

Do not add UI libraries outside D020 / `docs/18-UI-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md` merely for convenience.

Prioritize SEO, accessibility, security, mobile reading experience, simple author workflows, visual-contract fidelity, performance, and maintainability.

Do not infer stage authorization from a branch name, visual prototype, research result, or partial implementation. `docs/13-PROJECT-STATUS.md` is the authoritative current-stage record.
